aboutPage.title: About
aboutPage.missionText: Seasonal Harvest is a practical guide to rediscovering vegetables at their true harvest moment. Eating seasonally is one of the simplest gestures for your health, for local producers, and for the planet.
aboutPage.why1: Produce harvested at peak ripeness, richer in vitamins and minerals.
aboutPage.why2: Less transport and heated greenhouses — a reduced carbon footprint.
aboutPage.why3: Direct support for local producers and short supply chains.
aboutPage.why4: Authentic flavours and greater culinary diversity throughout the year.
aboutPage.dataText: Our database covers 38 common vegetables available in France, with their peak season calendar, nutritional values, storage methods and culinary pairings.
